synopsis: ISO 19206 specifies standardized surrogate targets for road-vehicle crash-avoidance testing, including pedestrian, bicycle and vehicle targets [f13499, f15312]. Euro NCAP’s 2026–2028 protocols and Virtual Testing v1.00 cover ISO 19206 targets; the 2026 protocols contain more than 1,200 scenarios and use these targets [f2846, f15445]. The corpus identifies standardized targets as a precondition for comparable tests, but reports that no off-road equivalent of ISO 19206 exists [f15328, f15329]. Chapter 3 therefore recommends transferring the family’s target-design principle rather than copying its on-road targets; off-road surrogates must represent people in protective clothing, light vehicles under a haul truck’s nose, machines and fixed obstacles [f2554, f15325].
